model.name: BUG14: /trace leaf file (link.url) detail renders BLANK — tagMap maps to unregistered rb-file-detail.
model.description: BUG: in /trace, clicking a LEAF file item (e.g. link.url) opens the detail drawer but it renders BLANK. Root cause: the tagMap maps file-type scenario units to 'rb-file-detail' custom element which is UNREGISTERED/nonexistent (never defined). The browser creates an unknown element that renders nothing. FIX: either (a) remove 'file' from tagMap so it falls through to the GENERIC detail view (which works for all types), OR (b) actually build and register rb-file-detail as a real custom element with ContentPreviewer integration. Option (a) is the minimal fix. Tron evidence: IMG_4018-20.
model.tronQuote: > TRON (device screenshot): /trace leaf file detail renders blank.
model.crossRefNote: R19.93 (file detail view has Preview button) defined the intended file detail. BUG9 = the tagMap routes to a nonexistent component, so no detail renders at all.

intendedChain.test: RED: click a .url file in /trace → detail shows file metadata + preview button (not blank). Currently FAILS (blank — rb-file-detail undefined).
